description: RuleFoundry finds Extractions you created or that were assigned to you, shows their status and RuleFoundry link, and makes finalized artifacts from completed Extractions available as cited source material for planning, code, documents, and analysis. After you confirm the exact topic, optional description, and participant, it can create one Extraction request for you or an external email address. RuleFoundry sends the external invitation automatically. Extraction sessions still happen in RuleFoundry; the plugin cannot start, conduct, continue, complete, resend, modify, or delete them.
